name: premise
label: There is an art to becoming who you are.
description: Brought across from a page made elsewhere; every word, picture and link is a field.

defaults.heading: There is an art to becoming who you are.

lines.lines: Not perfecting yourself into some final form.

defaults.text: But learning to see what is here. To know what is true. To loosen what obscures it. To listen for what wants to move through you. And to cultivate a life that can hold more of who you actually are.
defaults.text2: This is the heart of my work. A practice of remembering and becoming, again and again.
